theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_ce_annular_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P) (y v : Euclid P) (ρ₂ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → closedBall y ρ₂ ⊆ D → μ (closedBall y ρ₂) ≠ ∞ → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ ≤ 1) → ‖v‖ ≤ 1 → (∀ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ₂ → (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (μ (closedBall y r)).toReal ≤ ∫ z in closedBall y r, inner ℝ (ν z) v ∂μ) → ∀ ρ δ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ρ + δ < ρ₂ → ENNReal.ofReal δ * μ (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 3 * volume (F ∩ (ball y (ρ + δ) \ closedBall y ρ))
